target.title: fix(feishu): pass timeoutMs through app-registration guarded fetch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Feishu app-registration HTTP went through `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without a top-level `timeoutMs`. Sibling Feishu surfaces (`streaming-card`) already pass `timeoutMs` so undici dispatcher + guarded abort both fire. Registration previously relied only on `AbortSignal.timeout` inside `RequestInit`, which does not configure the guarded-fetch dispatcher hang floor the same way.

A Feishu/Lark accounts peer that accepts TCP but never returns headers could stall onboarding / QR registration longer than intended, especially if `init.signal` is dropped on a future refactor.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wire `timeoutMs` into `fetchFeishuJson` → `fetchWithSsrFGuard`, matching the streaming-card pattern:

- Default floor: existing `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` (10s) — keeps the tighter wizard budget (not the 30s `FEISHU_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS` API client default)
- Optional `timeoutMs` on registration fetch options for tests / overrides
- Remove redundant `init.signal` timeouts now owned by the guarded fetch

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** Registration HTTP depended on `RequestInit.signal` alone; guarded-fetch `timeoutMs` / dispatcher hang floor was unset.

**After:** Every registration JSON call installs a 10s guarded `timeoutMs`. Hung accounts endpoints reject with `TimeoutError: request timed out`.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.ts`
- Production caller under test: `beginAppRegistration` → `postRegistration` → `fetchFeishuJson` → `fetchWithSsrFGuard` against a local hung HTTP server (SSRF-redirected accounts host)
- Regression: `extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts`
- ClawSweeper follow-up: non-Vitest standalone runtime proof of the same production caller, including the full 10s default floor

### Caller-path hang proof (Vitest)

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
[feishu fetchFeishuJson hang proof] timed_out=true name=TimeoutError
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > times out registration POSTs when accounts never return headers 90ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 6.06s
```

## Real behavior proof

**Commands run:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts --reporter=verbose
PROOF_MODE=short node --import tsx /tmp/openclaw-feishu-registration-timeout-proof/standalone.mts
PROOF_MODE=production-floor node --import tsx /tmp/openclaw-feishu-registration-timeout-proof/standalone.mts
```

**Before fix:**
`fetchFeishuJson` called `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without `timeoutMs`. Registration relied only on `RequestInit.signal = AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)`.

**After fix:**
`beginAppRegistration` against a server that accepts TCP but never returns headers rejects with `TimeoutError: request timed out` via the guarded-fetch floor:

1. Short standalone run (`timeoutMs: 80` stand-in)
2. Production-floor standalone run (omit override → default `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000`)

Source wiring also verified in the standalone harness: `timeoutMs` forwarded into `fetchWithSsrFGuard`, redundant `init.signal` timeouts removed, production floor = 10000.

**Evidence after fix (Vitest):**
```text
[feishu fetchFeishuJson hang proof] timed_out=true name=TimeoutError
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > times out registration POSTs when accounts never return headers 90ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 6.06s
```

**Evidence after fix (standalone, non-Vitest, short):**
```text
[standalone] source_timeout_default=true source_guard_timeoutMs=true source_post_forward=true source_no_init_signal=true production_timeout_ms=10000
[standalone] mode=short hang_http_peer=http://127.0.0.1:49693 caller=beginAppRegistration timeoutMs=80
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 80ms (elapsed 81ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=https://accounts.feishu.cn/oauth/v1/app/registration
[standalone] timeout_or_error name=TimeoutError message=request timed out elapsed_ms=126 accepted_connections=1
[standalone] RESULT timed_out=true elapsed_ok=true expected_floor_ms=80 production_timeout_ms=10000
```

**Evidence after fix (standalone, non-Vitest, production 10s floor):**
```text
[standalone] source_timeout_default=true source_guard_timeoutMs=true source_post_forward=true source_no_init_signal=true production_timeout_ms=10000
[standalone] mode=production-floor hang_http_peer=http://127.0.0.1:49743 caller=beginAppRegistration timeoutMs=default(10000)
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 10000ms (elapsed 10003ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=https://accounts.feishu.cn/oauth/v1/app/registration
[standalone] timeout_or_error name=TimeoutError message=request timed out elapsed_ms=10054 accepted_connections=1
[standalone] RESULT timed_out=true elapsed_ok=true expected_floor_ms=10000 production_timeout_ms=10000
```

**What was not tested:**
Live Feishu/Lark accounts credentials / QR scan UI; gateway packaging beyond the production `beginAppRegistration` → `fetchWithSsrFGuard` path used by onboarding.
